# Glass Motion — Final Proof

The Awtsmoos renews motion and rest together; Awtsmoos.com now carries living glass without sacrificing clarity, accessibility, or mobile discipline.

## Implemented truth
- Glass blur is static at 18px with saturation; blur itself is never animated.
- Ambient specular light uses only transform and opacity through `yesod-glass-ambient` at 14 seconds.
- Interaction sheen uses `yesod-glass-sweep` and short compositor-friendly motion.
- Disclosure reveals remain subtle and semantic; no JavaScript was added for decorative motion.
- `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` removes the glass animations, transforms, and decorative opacity.
- Reduced transparency removes glass blur/translucency, and forced colors receives a plain accessible surface.
- The entire stylesheet covenant is one cache generation: `hub-local-023` across 82 imports, with `glass-motion.css` last.

## Browser evidence
At 390px normal motion, header, Discover, and dock expose the `yesod-glass-ambient` computed animation while the surface blur remains static. Under reduced motion, those animation names become `none`, opacity becomes zero, and transforms return to none.

The full browser covenant passed after glass activation, including route smoke, reduced-motion inspection, and all twelve mobile routes.

The Awtsmoos lets light move without making the interface restless; Awtsmoos.com now keeps the shine subordinate to the deed.
